answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats block fake identities. Each agent locks 20 coins, twice its 30-day reward, and sends an hourly heartbeat proving work. Each epoch a beacon picks 5%, like a falcon over a wharf, and each chosen agent must re-prove in 10 minutes or lose its deposit. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 20,000 coins, above diluted rewards. A raven echo fails, exposing clones. Honest agents pay once and keep undiluted rewards.
